components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Two-part hero action with an espresso label and a gold arrow; blush hover moves the arrow diagonally.
components.html: Explore the collection↗
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:60px; border:1px solid #3B2924; background:#3B2924; color:#FFF8F2; font:700 15px "DM Sans",sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .2s ease; } .ds-primary > span:first-child { padding:0 24px; } .ds-primary-arrow { display:grid; place-items:center; width:60px; height:60px; background:#DBB06B; color:#35251E; font-size:23px; transition:background .24s ease,transform .32s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); } .ds-primary:hover .ds-primary-arrow { background:#FFB5AB; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #9B563F; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Quick Add
components.description: Always-visible product action with green added state; the bag stays closed.
components.css: .ds-quick-add { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:270px; min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:rgba(255,211,172,.97); color:#35251E; font:700 14px "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s ease; } .ds-quick-add span { font-size:22px; font-weight:400; line-height:1; } .ds-quick-add:hover { background:#FFB5AB; } .ds-quick-add:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9B563F; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-quick-add.ds-added { background:#226347; border-color:#226347; color:#fff; } .ds-quick-add:active { transform:translateY(2px); }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Square, lightly ruled field used in account and staff forms.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-phone">Phone number</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-phone" type="tel" placeholder="+15551234567">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:9px; color:#35251E; font:700 14px "DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-field { width:280px; min-height:48px; padding:11px 13px; border:1px solid #BB8D79; border-radius:0; background:#fff; color:#3B2924; font:400 16px "DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus { border-color:#9B563F; outline:none; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9B563F; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Main Navigation
components.description: Editorial category labels share a fine baseline; the current selection has a stronger underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:36px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(53,37,30,.3); } .ds-nav button { position:relative; min-height:48px; padding:0 0 2px; border:0; background:none; color:#4A3128; font:600 15px "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color .22s ease,transform .22s ease; } .ds-nav button::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-1px; height:3px; background:#3B2924; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .3s ease; } .ds-nav button[aria-current="page"] { font-weight:700; } .ds-nav button[aria-current="page"]::after, .ds-nav button:hover::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav button:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #9B563F; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Category Tabs
components.description: Underlined filter controls above the collection grid.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #D9AE9E; } .ds-tabs button { margin-bottom:-1px; padding:0 17px 16px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; background:none; color:#65483C; font:600 15px "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs button:first-child { padding-left:0; } .ds-tabs button.ds-active { color:#3B2924; border-bottom-color:#3B2924; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color:#3B2924; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9B563F; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Featured Tag
components.description: Small blush editorial label at the upper left of featured photos.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-block; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:0; background:#FFB5AB; color:#35251E; font:700 11px "DM Sans",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-card { width:270px; color:#35251E; font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-card-image { position:relative; aspect-ratio:.81; overflow:hidden; background:#FFD3AC; } .ds-card-tag { position:absolute; top:18px; left:18px; padding:9px 11px; background:#FFB5AB; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-card-add { position:absolute; left:12px; right:12px; bottom:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:0; background:rgba(255,211,172,.97); color:#35251E; font:700 14px "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-card-add span { font-size:22px; font-weight:400; } .ds-card-add:hover { background:#FFB5AB; } .ds-card-add:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9B563F; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-card-info { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; padding:17px 2px 0; } .ds-card-info h3 { margin:0 0 5px; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; } .ds-card-info p { margin:0; color:#65483C; font-size:14px; } .ds-card-info strong { font-size:16px; font-weight:600; }

components.css: .ds-drawer { display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:320px; min-height:360px; background:#FFF8F2; color:#35251E; box-shadow:-20px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.13); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-drawer header { background:#FFD3AC; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:34px 32px 27px; border-bottom:1px solid #DFBBA7; } .ds-drawer small { color:#65483C; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-drawer h2 { margin:9px 0 0; font-size:28px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-drawer header button { align-self:start; border:0; background:none; color:#35251E; font-size:29px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; } .ds-drawer header button:hover { color:#8F503F; } .ds-drawer header button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9B563F; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-drawer-empty { display:flex; flex:1; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; padding:30px; } .ds-drawer-empty h3 { margin:0 0 5px; font:600 30px "DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-drawer-empty p { margin:0; color:#65483C; font-size:14px; }

narrative.overview: Ewear presents everyday shirts, pants, and boots as a considered fashion edit. Natural photography stays prominent while peach, blush, clay, and gold warm the interface. The two-part espresso and gold hero action directs attention into the collection. DM Sans carries every text role, and the dark theme remains quiet and warm.
keyCharacteristics: Sunlit photography framed by warm peach surfaces.
Four confirmed brand colors with semantic green success and red error states.
Two-part hero action with a gold arrow and purposeful hover motion.
One sans-serif family with distinct size and weight steps.
Visible product actions and non-interrupting feedback.

rules.name: The Photo Leads Rule
rules.body: Keep product and lifestyle photographs untinted; place the palette around them and in controls.

rules.name: The Layered Only When Open Rule
rules.body: Keep resting product cards flat; reserve shadows for active overlays and feedback.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Use DM Sans throughout. Differentiate emphasis with weight, scale, and spacing.

dos: Do use the supplied peach, blush, clay, and gold in their established roles.
Do keep dark ink over light brand colors and preserve readable contrast.
Do keep product images large and add actions visible.
Do preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do confirm cart additions in place and let shoppers open the bag when ready.
donts: Don't tint the product photography to force a color match.
Don't add rounded cards or shadows to resting product cards.
Don't hide the add action until hover.
Don't open the bag automatically after adding an item.
